name: solidping
description: Uptime monitoring through the SolidPing MCP server: checks, results, incidents and status pages.

interface.shortDescription: Uptime checks, incidents and status pages from the SolidPing MCP server.
interface.longDescription: SolidPing is open-source uptime monitoring (AGPL-3.0): 40+ check types, multi-region workers, incidents, on-call escalation and status pages. This plugin connects Codex to its remote MCP server (OAuth 2.1) and adds a skill: read checks, results and incidents, diagnose a failing check, and create or change checks and status pages after you confirm. Works with the hosted service at solidping.io; a self-hosted instance serves the same endpoint.
defaultPrompt: Which of my SolidPing checks are down right now?
Why is this check failing? Diagnose it with SolidPing.
Add an HTTPS check on this URL every minute from two regions.
